StarPilot no longer recognizes this phone pairing. Pair again to restore Bluetooth Galaxy and music.
Pair this phone to use Galaxy without Wi-Fi and set up Bluetooth music.

%1$s

1. Keep StarPilot parked, stay connected over Wi-Fi, and turn on Bluetooth on both devices.

2. Tap Add pairing. The app opens the StarPilot pairing window automatically.

3. Allow Nearby devices if asked, then approve the Bluetooth pairing prompt on this phone. Confirm the code matches if one is shown.

4. Wait for the app to confirm pairing is complete. If needed, choose StarPilot as your phone Bluetooth audio output.
